name: Look up a member by number or last name
goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the given operator, then search for the member using the given member number, and open that member's record. Read back the member's full name and status as shown on the record screen.

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Full name shown on the member record.

outputs.name: member_status
outputs.description: Status shown on the member record (e.g. active).

business_outcomes.description: No member record matches the given member number — a legitimate negative result.
